title: 雅思口语 #1 · 家乡 / 学习 / 城市话题
goal: 口语随机话题训练：Part 1 日常问答 ×3、Part 2 人物卡片 ×1、Part 3 延伸讨论 ×2。只出题不批改，自行开口练习（准备 1 分钟 · 陈述 1-2 分钟）；练完点「完成练习」，本卷会展示每个话题的地道表达参考供优化回答。

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about your hometown.
- Do you like the place where you live now? Why or why not?
- What is the most interesting part of your hometown?
- Would you like to live there in the future?

suggestions.en: The street food here is cheap and tasty.
suggestions.zh: 这边的小吃便宜又好吃（食）

suggestions.en: I live in a flat in the city centre.
suggestions.zh: 我住在市中心的一套公寓里（住）

suggestions.en: Public transport is really convenient — you can get anywhere by metro.
suggestions.zh: 公共交通很方便，坐地铁哪儿都能到（行）

suggestions.en: Everything I need is within walking distance.
suggestions.zh: 要用的东西走路就能买到（行/住）

suggestions.en: Renting here is more affordable than in the capital.
suggestions.zh: 这边房租比首都便宜（住）

suggestions.en: The pace of life here is much more relaxed.
suggestions.zh: 这里的生活节奏慢得多

suggestions.en: It has four distinct seasons, so there's always something to enjoy.
suggestions.zh: 四季分明，每个季节都有可看的

suggestions.en: It's a friendly place where neighbours know each other.
suggestions.zh: 邻里都认识，人情味浓

suggestions.en: I've grown up here, so it will always feel like home.
suggestions.zh: 我在这儿长大，永远觉得这里才是家

suggestions.en: It's a great place to settle down and bring up a family.
suggestions.zh: 很适合安定下来、成家育儿

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about work or study.
- Do you work or are you a student?
- What do you like most about your job or studies?
- Do you prefer studying in the morning or in the evening? Why?

suggestions.en: I'm currently doing a degree in business.
suggestions.zh: 我目前在读商科学位

suggestions.en: I'm in my final year, so the workload is quite heavy.
suggestions.zh: 我读最后一年，课业很重

suggestions.en: I usually hit the books in the library after class.
suggestions.zh: 下课后我常在图书馆用功

suggestions.en: What I enjoy most is the group discussions in class.
suggestions.zh: 我最喜欢课堂上的小组讨论

suggestions.en: I prefer studying in the morning when my mind is fresh.
suggestions.zh: 我更喜欢早上脑子清醒时学习

suggestions.en: I'm hoping to land a job in marketing after graduation.
suggestions.zh: 毕业后我想进市场营销这一行

suggestions.en: A good work-life balance matters more to me than a high salary.
suggestions.zh: 对我来说，工作生活平衡比高薪更重要

suggestions.en: My colleagues are supportive and easy to work with.
suggestions.zh: 同事很支持，也好相处

questions.prompt:
Let's talk about the weather.
- What kind of weather do you like most? Why?
- Does the weather affect your mood?
- What do you usually do when it rains?

suggestions.en: The weather here is mild for most of the year.
suggestions.zh: 这里一年大部分时间气候温和

suggestions.en: I love sunny spells after a few days of rain.
suggestions.zh: 连下几天雨后的放晴，我最喜欢

suggestions.en: It was pouring with rain this morning.
suggestions.zh: 今天早上下了倾盆大雨

suggestions.en: Gloomy days do make me feel a bit low.
suggestions.zh: 阴沉的天确实让我有点没精神

suggestions.en: There's nothing better than a crisp autumn morning.
suggestions.zh: 秋高气爽的早晨最舒服

suggestions.en: In winter you really need to wrap up warm.
suggestions.zh: 冬天必须穿得暖暖的

suggestions.en: I don't really mind the rain — it keeps the air fresh.
suggestions.zh: 我倒不太介意下雨，雨后空气新鲜

suggestions.en: The summers here are hot and humid, which can be draining.
suggestions.zh: 这里夏天湿热，挺耗人的

questions.prompt:
Describe a city you have visited that you remember well.

You should say:
- where the city is
- when you visited it
- what you did there

and explain why you remember this city so well.

suggestions.en: The old town is beautifully preserved.
suggestions.zh: 老城区保存得非常完好

suggestions.en: The skyline at night is absolutely breathtaking.
suggestions.zh: 夜晚的天际线美得惊人

suggestions.en: I spent the afternoons just wandering around the streets.
suggestions.zh: 我下午就在街上随意闲逛

suggestions.en: There's a lively night market where you can try local snacks.
suggestions.zh: 有个很热闹的夜市，能尝到本地小吃

suggestions.en: I soaked up the atmosphere from a café by the river.
suggestions.zh: 我坐在河边的咖啡店感受当地氛围

suggestions.en: Every corner seemed to have a story to tell.
suggestions.zh: 每个角落似乎都有故事

suggestions.en: It left a lasting impression on me.
suggestions.zh: 它给我留下了深刻的印象

suggestions.en: The locals were incredibly welcoming.
suggestions.zh: 当地人格外热情好客

suggestions.en: I'd recommend it to anyone who loves history and good food.
suggestions.zh: 我会把它推荐给所有爱历史、爱美食的人

suggestions.en: It was a real eye-opener for me.
suggestions.zh: 那次旅行真让我大开眼界

questions.prompt:
Part 3 延伸讨论（基于「城市」话题）：
- How has tourism changed in your country in recent years?
- Do you think cities are becoming too crowded? Why?
- What could governments do to improve life in big cities?

suggestions.en: The recent travel boom has transformed the city centre.
suggestions.zh: 近年的旅游热彻底改变了市中心

suggestions.en: Some tourist hotspots are overcrowded at weekends.
suggestions.zh: 一些热门景点周末人满为患

suggestions.en: Overtourism can put a real strain on local resources.
suggestions.zh: 过度旅游会给当地资源带来实际压力

suggestions.en: Locals tend to get off the beaten track to avoid the crowds.
suggestions.zh: 本地人往往去小众路线避开人流

suggestions.en: Seasonal influxes of visitors drive up prices for residents.
suggestions.zh: 旺季游客涌入会抬高居民的生活成本

suggestions.en: A balance needs to be struck between tourism and daily life.
suggestions.zh: 旅游发展与日常生活之间需要取得平衡

questions.prompt:
Part 3 延伸讨论（基于「城市」话题）：
- Why do many young people prefer living in cities to living in the countryside?
- Do you think the advantages of city life outweigh the disadvantages? Why?
- How might cities change in the next 50 years?

suggestions.en: Urban sprawl is one of the biggest challenges cities face.
suggestions.zh: 城市无序扩张是城市面临的最大挑战之一

suggestions.en: More green spaces would make cities far more liveable.
suggestions.zh: 更多绿地会让城市宜居得多

suggestions.en: Smart city initiatives could cut traffic and energy use.
suggestions.zh: 智慧城市举措能减少拥堵和能源消耗

suggestions.en: Affordable housing is the key to keeping young people in cities.
suggestions.zh: 可负担的住房是把年轻人留在城市的关键

suggestions.en: Remote working has already eased the pressure on commuting.
suggestions.zh: 远程办公已经缓解了通勤压力

suggestions.en: Future cities will be built around public transport, not cars.
suggestions.zh: 未来的城市会围绕公共交通而建，而不是汽车

suggestions.en: Cities are engines of opportunity and innovation.
suggestions.zh: 城市是机遇与创新的引擎
